spec.name: A
spec.query: ( sum by (label_resource_name, namespace) ( kube_pod_status_ready{condition="true",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{label_resource_name=~"ai-python-app|ai-python-worker",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) / sum by (label_resource_name, namespace) ( kube_pod_info{namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} * on(pod, namespace) group_left(label_resource_name) kube_pod_labels{label_resource_name=~"ai-python-app|ai-python-worker",namespace="<NAMESPACE>"} ) )

annotations.resolution: Ready replicas low. kubectl -n {{ $labels.namespace }} get pods; check failing pods, recent rollout, and resource pressure.
